rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for delaying a scheduled event, appointment, or activity.

example.english: Because of the typhoon, we had to postpone the outdoor event.
example.traditional: 因為打風，我哋要延期個戶外活動。
example.jyutping: jan1 wai6 daa2 fung1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jin4 kei4 go3 wu6 ngoi6 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when postponing something specifically means moving it to a different date or time.

example.english: The dentist said we need to postpone our appointment to another date.
example.traditional: 牙醫話我哋個預約要改期。
example.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ngo5 dei6 go3 jyu6 joek3 jiu3 goi2 kei4

rows.note: Use this casual construction when putting off doing an action until later rather than rescheduling a fixed event.

example.english: I’ll postpone doing the homework; I have to leave now.
example.traditional: 份功課遲啲先做啦，我而家要出門口。
example.jyutping: fan2 gung1 fo3 ci4 di1 sin1 zou6 laa1 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 ceot1 mun4 hau2
